answer: A farming ring can clone keys overnight, but it cannot fake a tide of corroborating history. Every attestation is watermarked by the juniper-hash of the attester's prior 40 closes: peers recompute who was online when. A vine of mutual votes that sprouts with no upstream watermark trail marks the whole cluster for a 90-day weight freeze. Attackers must then rent real time on many accounts - the one input no sybil budget buys cheap.
